0022600217.text: The Pacers (3-8, 0-5 at home, 2-8 in their last ten, on a two-game losing streak) host the Washington Wizards (3-7, 2-5 on the road, on a four-game losing streak), with Indiana 12th in the East and Washington 10th. Indiana sits 4.5 games back in the Central and Washington is 3 games back in the Southeast, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, though the Pacers lost 1-3 to Washington in the 2025-26 season series and most recently fell 131-118 in Washington on February 20, 2026. Currently unavailable for Indiana are Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring, day-to-day and a game-time decision), while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve).
